desc:
Both players will be given an EXE and they have to draw the EXE better! 💀

🤖 AI judges each drawing based on accuracy (%)
🏆 The higher score wins the round!
💀 Winner gets the EXE!

Earn money from EXEs to unlock upgrades, cosmetics. and more!

⚠️ Inappropriate artwork is not tolerated and may result in a permanent ban.

Controls 🕹️
1–7 = Assigned drawing tools

⬅️ Undo: Ctrl + Z
➡️ Redo: Ctrl + Y

Can you outdraw your opponent and create the better drawing before time runs out?

❤️ Enjoying Draw an EXE!? Leave a 👍 and ⭐ to support future updates!
